# 575. Distribute Candies

## Solution 1 (time O(n), space O(1))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def distributeCandies(self, candyType):
        """
        :type candyType: List[int]
        :rtype: int
        """
        n1 = len(set(candyType))
        n2 = len(candyType) // 2
        if n1 >= n2:
            return n2
        else:
            return n1
```
